model_output.rationale: PR-27 on all lines from a commercial payer (CI). 271 confirms EB*6 (inactive) with eligibility end 2025-05-31, DOS 2025-06-17 falls after termination. No successor payer, no EB*R. Group PR = patient liability. Commercial hold-harmless does not reach a non-member. Bill patient.

root_cause.explanation: Patient's Keystone EPO coverage ended 2025-05-31. DOS 2025-06-17 is 17 days post-termination. 271 confirms EB*6 inactive, DTP*357 before DOS. No other payer on file.

next_action.detail: Issue patient statement for $204.23. Verify no other active coverage before billing. If patient reports new insurance effective on DOS, bill that payer instead.

evidence.fact: All 4 lines denied PR-27 (expenses after coverage terminated), total $204.23 patient responsibility
EB*6 (inactive), eligibility end DTP*357 = 2025-05-31, DOS queried 2025-06-17
Claim-level MOA remark N30 (patient ineligible for this service)
Filing indicator CI (commercial), subscriber is self (code 18)

citations.rule: CI, EB*6 + 357 before DOS, no successor: PR-27 → bill_patient after overrides cleared
PR = patient responsibility, billable after QMB/Medicaid/NSA/ABN overrides cleared
